notes.title: Momoiro Closet's release date
notes.notes:
We wanted to let everyone know that the Steam release of Momoiro Closet will be delayed. While we can't yet say exactly when the game will be released, we expect this to be a short delay, and will continue to keep you updated with as much information as we are able to share.
In the meantime, we encourage you to check out the demo and build your excitement for the game!
